title: Psionics team at work on the night of the eight-gon recovery

tellings.quote: And there was a psionics team working that night.

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he flew in the recovery of an unknown craft in the California desert in 2014, tells Michels that "there was a psionics team working that night." Psionics here means people trained to use the mind to sense or influence things at a distance, and he speaks as someone who says he was there. If true, it would mean mind-based methods were being used in craft recoveries.
